answer: Sponsors that share a rack should not mint a voter. Admission is a 16-hour thaw: three mutually-unrelated incumbents each lock 11.4 POA, and the applicant settles 7.2 POA of trades with six distinct counterparties inside a glacier cold-path escrow that stamps packet RTT. The saffron desk averages those three sponsor RTTs; variance under 8ms slashes 40% of every note and rejects the batch as co-located. Copying a 32-byte note nonce across a whisper side-channel onto a second applicant burns both notes. If a sponsor goes dark, the lock returns minus 0.6 POA and the slot is released.
